categories.name: 1. Street Surface & Debris (Potholes, Roadkill, Obstructions)
categories.description: Report potholes, asphalt damage, roadkill removal on street/alley, fallen road debris, or missed trash collection.

questions.label: Type of Roadway / Surface Hazard
options: Deceased Animal Removal (Roadkill on Public Street)

questions.label: Traffic Impact
options: Partially - Drivers must slow down or swerve
Completely - Lane or alley completely blocked

questions.label: Location Details & Description
questions.placeholder: e.g. Deep pothole or roadkill in eastbound lane near 200 W Canal St.

categories.name: 2. Traffic Signals, Signs & Road Control Devices
categories.description: Report broken or dark traffic lights, knocked-down stop/yield signs, missing street markers, or damaged signal poles.

questions.label: Traffic Infrastructure Issue
options: Damaged or Knocked-Down Stop / Yield Sign
Damaged Traffic Signal Pole / Push Button

questions.label: Intersection or Location Details
questions.placeholder: e.g. Stop sign knocked down at the corner of Broadway and Main St.

categories.name: 3. Hazardous Trees, Foliage & Sign Visibility Obstructions
categories.department: Peru Street Dept / Utility Line Trim / Parks Dept
categories.description: Report overgrown branches blocking stop signs/sightlines, fallen limbs blocking roads, or tree branches threatening power/telecom wires.

questions.label: Foliage / Tree Safety Hazard
options: Overgrown Tree / Hedge Obscuring Stop Sign or Intersection View
Fallen Tree Branch Blocking Roadway / Alley / Sidewalk
Tree Limb Resting on Wires (Power / Telecom)
Dead or Leaning Municipal Tree Posing Immediate Fall Risk

questions.label: Is the tree touching power or utility lines?
options: Yes - Touching or tangled in electrical / telecom lines

questions.label: Specific Location & Visual Description
questions.placeholder: e.g. Low pine branch completely blocks view of stop sign approaching 5th & Broadway.

categories.name: 4. Storm Drains, Flooding & Railroad Underpass (Broadway Tunnel)
categories.description: Report clogged storm drain catch basins, standing water at the Broadway Tunnel underpass, or localized street flooding.

questions.label: Drainage / Flooding Problem
options: Railroad Underpass Flooded / Standing Water (Broadway Tunnel)
Clogged Storm Drain Inlet / Leaf & Trash Accumulation
Creek Bank Erosion / Riverbank / Ditch Washout
Stormwater Contamination / Illegal Dumping in Drain

questions.label: Specific Location & Water Depth Details
questions.placeholder: e.g. Broadway underpass flooded with 6+ inches of standing water after heavy rain.

categories.name: 5. Water Main Leaks, Running Water & Sewage Odors
categories.department: Peru Utilities - Division of Water Management
categories.description: Report gushing water leaks, water bubbling from street/curb, low pressure, discolored water, or raw sewage backup/smell.

questions.label: Water / Sewer Issue Type
options: Suspected Water Main Break / Gushing Water in Street or Yard
Water Bubbling Up From Curb / Sidewalk
Sewage Odor / Raw Sewer Line Backup

questions.label: Report Urgency
options: Active Water Main Break / Property Threat

questions.label: Location & Observed Conditions
questions.placeholder: e.g. Water stream flowing out from lawn near meter pit in front of 120 E 3rd St.

categories.name: 6. Natural Gas Smell or Pipeline Hazard (NIPSCO)
categories.description: Report suspected natural gas leaks or rotten egg odors. IF YOU SMELL GAS INSIDE OR NEAR BUILDINGS, EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY AND CALL 911.

questions.label: Gas Incident Type
options: Outdoor Rotten Egg / Sulfur Smell Near Street or Alley
Hissing Sound Near Gas Meter or Main Line
Damaged Gas Line During Excavation / Digging

questions.label: Location & Details
questions.placeholder: e.g. Distinct rotten egg gas odor near alley meter behind 45 N Broadway.

categories.name: 7. Animal Care & Control (Loose, Injured, or Stray Animals)
categories.department: Peru Animal Care & Control (Greg Douglass, Officer)
categories.description: Report stray dogs running loose, aggressive or nuisance animals, injured wildlife, or lost/found pets.

questions.label: Type of Animal Issue
options: Stray Animal Loose in Traffic / Neighborhood

questions.label: Animal Description & Last Known Location
questions.placeholder: e.g. Brown lab mix running loose near Broadway. Friendly but heading towards highway.

categories.name: 8. Parks & Recreation Facilities (Damage, Vandalism, Playgrounds)
categories.description: Report broken playground equipment, damaged park shelters, trash overflow in parks, or vandalism at Maconaquah Park & municipal facilities.

questions.label: Park Issue Type
options: Vandalism or Graffiti on Park Structure
Fallen Tree Branch on Park Trail or Play Area

questions.label: Park / Facility Name
questions.placeholder: e.g. Maconaquah Park, Miami's Fort, Riverwalk, Municipal Golf Course

questions.label: Specific Location & Context
questions.placeholder: e.g. Broken swing chain on the west swing set near the big playground shelter.

categories.name: 9. Electric Power Outage & Street Light Outages
categories.department: Peru Utilities Line Department (Michael Biesenbach, T&D Supt)
categories.description: Report street light outages, flickering neighborhood lights, damaged utility poles, or localized electric outages.

questions.label: Electrical Issue
options: Street Light Out / Flickering Dark at Night

questions.label: Pole Tag Number or Nearest Address
questions.placeholder: e.g. Metal tag number on pole or nearest street address

questions.label: Additional Context
questions.placeholder: e.g. Street light over intersection flickers on and off every few minutes.

categories.name: 10. Blocked Railroad Crossing (Stopped Trains)
categories.description: Report stopped or blocking trains at local grade crossings directly to Federal Railroad Administration safety tracking.

questions.label: How long has the crossing been blocked?
Train Details / Engine Number (if visible)
questions.placeholder: e.g. Norfolk Southern train completely stopped across Broadway. Engine # if visible.

categories.name: 11. High Grass, Blight, Junk Vehicles & Code Violations
categories.department: Building & Zoning Dept (Bruce Carson, Comm. / Bill Sheets, Code Enf.)
categories.description: Report tall grass (>8 inches), junk/blight accumulation in yards, abandoned/inoperable vehicles, or unsafe structures.

questions.label: Code Violation Category
options: Trash, Junk, or Blight in Yard or Alley

questions.label: Specific Description of Violation
questions.placeholder: e.g. Overgrown grass exceeding 12 inches with trash piling up near back alley.

categories.name: 12. Sidewalks, Trip Hazards & ADA Curb Aprons
categories.description: Report buckled or cracked sidewalks, severe tripping hazards, sunken curb ramps, or blocked public walkways.

questions.label: Walkway Hazard
options: Tree Root Buckled Sidewalk / Severe Lipping Hazard
Damaged ADA Curb Ramp / Tactile Mat

questions.label: Location & Context
questions.placeholder: e.g. Large 3-inch concrete lip caused by tree roots outside 220 N Broadway.

categories.name: 13. State Highway Issue (US 24, US 31, SR 19, SR 124)
categories.department: Indiana Dept of Transportation (INDOT Fort Wayne District)
categories.description: Report issues on state routes (US 24, US 31, SR 19, SR 124) directly to INDOT, as they are outside municipal jurisdiction.

questions.label: Issue Type
options: State Highway Pothole / Bridge Deck Damage

questions.label: Mile Marker or Nearest Intersection
questions.placeholder: e.g. Deep pothole on US 31 northbound ramp at SR 19 exit.

categories.name: 14. Unlisted / Missing Category (Report to Site Admin)
categories.department: Peru Community 311 - Site Maintainer & Civic Tech Team
categories.description: Can't find a matching department above? Send a report to the site admin so we can direct you to the correct agency or update templates.json.

questions.label: What kind of municipal issue are you trying to report?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Airport runway lighting, noise complaint, county bridge issue

questions.label: Which entity do you believe should handle this?
options: Private Utility (NIPSCO, Comcast, Indiana Michigan Power)

questions.label: Detailed Summary & Suggestions for Site Improvement
questions.placeholder: Describe the issue and why an unlisted category is needed. The maintainer will reply with guidance or open a GitHub issue to add the category.
